messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync: we need a compact, actionable gating matrix for geo cutover + tenant isolation asks from Acme. I sketched a lightweight plan. Thoughts?

dylan (Eng): share. are we planning canary + staged traffic switching or blue/green?

maria (PM): canary + staged shift. flow: 1) sandbox validation, 2) single-tenant canary in staging, 3) 5% prod for 24h, 4) 50% then 100% if signals green. gating signals below.

jon (Arch): add one more gate: observe cold-start p95 for model variants under high KV miss. we saw regressions in Q3 during misses.

priya (SRE): +1. also require an automated fallback policy before canary: fallback to regional-compatible smaller model + circuit-breaker for sustained error spikes.

alex (Sales): Acme’s legal team will want cross-region failover within 30s and tail-latency SLA. can we put numbers on that?

maria (PM): draft launch signals (binary/pass thresholds):
- p99 user latency < 120ms for regional traffic
- error rate < 0.5% (5xx + model exceptions)
- regional failover recovery < 30s
- KV cache warmup for pinned tenants < 2 minutes
- no customer-visible quality regressions on top-10 prompts
(we can relax numbers if ops flags concerns)

dylan (Eng): p99 120ms is tight cross-region for some models. propose model-variant routing: default -> quantized variant under pressure. include in playbook.

jon (Arch): policy suggestion: SLA-triggered affinity. if tenant p99 > 200ms for >5m, move them to an affinity lane (isolated slice) automatically and notify account team. define a migration window.

priya (SRE): operational acceptance checklist before canary:
- alerts: region.failover.latency, tenant.p99.spike
- runbook: manual evacuation + slice pinning steps
- smoke harness: run top-20 prompts every 15m during canary; fail -> rollback

alex (Sales): Acme wants rollback SLA: if we rollback, they expect no more than 1 minute of degraded errors for their tenant. realistic?

dylan (Eng): 1 minute is optimistic for full restoration, but we can commit to automatic traffic cutover within 60s if fallback fires. full perf restoration depends on cache warmup and may take longer. be explicit in contract.

maria (PM): conservative contract language proposal: "automated failover within 60s to a compatible model variant; expected full performance restoration within 10 minutes under normal load".

jon (Arch): minimal launch checklist for platform team:
- routing policy versioned + sandbox tests
- canary automation (traffic shaping, automatic rollback)
- fallback variants configured and smoke-tested
- telemetry: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, cache hit ratio, failover events logged
- runbook + SLO docs for CS and Sales

priya (SRE): add chaos-window validation: simulate region outage during canary with one internal tenant first to validate failover and alerts.

maria (PM): timeline suggestion: prototype gating matrix + infra changes in sprint 2; internal pilot in sprint 3; customer pilot (Acme) in sprint 4 if pilot metrics pass.

alex (Sales): Acme wants pilot in ~6 weeks. can we accelerate to sprint 3 if pilot scoped to 2 tenants only?

dylan (Eng): doable if we narrow model sizes and disable cross-region routing for pilot; reduces blast radius.

jon (Arch): add acceptance signal: automated regression run vs baseline prompts using embedding-similarity + manual QA sign-off before widening rollout.

maria (PM): action items: @dylan draft routing policy PR with canary hooks; @priya author runbook + chaos test plan; @jon write acceptance signal checklist; @alex confirm contract wording with Acme and drop specifics here. I will collate and publish gating matrix doc.

ops-bot: Created ticket #1234: geo-cutover-gating. Owners: dylan, priya, jon, maria. ETA: 2025-07-11.

alex (Sales): noted, I'll push legal notes and pilot window. :thumbsup:

maria (PM): thanks everyone, I'll publish the first draft gating matrix by EOD for quick signoff.
